lines.text: The blessed man does not walk in the counsel of the wicked or sit in the seat of mockers.
His delight is in the Law of the LORD, and he meditates on it day and night.
He is like a tree planted on a high mountain, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither.
The wicked are like a rock, and they will not stand in the judgment.
The LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
